subject: Operations
title: Capacity Utilization Metrics
description: A 60-second lesson on Capacity Utilization Metrics.

hook.text: A factory reports 90% utilization but makes the wrong products. High utilization means nothing without alignment.

buildup.text: Utilization is actual output divided by design capacity. Efficiency is actual output divided by effective capacity.

discovery.text: Both metrics together reveal whether low output comes from poor planning or operational problems.

twist.text: Maximizing utilization of every resource locally can create system-wide problems—like inventory piles between steps.

climax.text: The best metric is throughput: how much valuable output the system delivers to customers per unit of time.

quiz.question: Why can high utilization be misleading?
options: The system may be producing the wrong things
